body: two years ago this weekend, the biggest free show of the eras tour happened *outside* the stadium. for the munich shows, tens of thousands of ticketless fans climbed a hill over the olympiastadion just to hear it — they nicknamed the spot "mount swiftie." from the stage taylor thanked "about 50,000 beautiful people outside the stadium." 🤍
